Egyptian parliament authorises military aid for Saudi Arabia — Legislators approve military support amid Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, but Cairo has ruled out strikes on Yemen.
Mecca defence alliance members in Tehran to defuse Iran-US, Yemen tensions — Countering Houthi advances in Yemen will be a major focus for Saudi Arabia and its allies in Tehran.

Netanyahu fights for political future as Israel heads to polls with Iran threat looming — Israel heads into a high-stakes election with Benjamin Netanyahu's political future and legacy on the line as voters weigh his security record and the continuing Iran threat.

Flurry of Diplomacy in Iran Amid Reports of U.S. and Israeli Plans to Renew War — Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan made a rare joint visit to Tehran amid reports that the U.S. and Israel were drawing up plans to renew their attacks on Iran.
Iran’s anti-negotiation hardliners turn against President Pezeshkian — Iran’s anti-negotiation hardliners turn against President Pezeshkian over negotiations with the US.

Trump's not on the ballot but swing state voters still cast ballots with MAGA in mind — Pennsylvania voters say they're voting Democratic in the midterms to rein in Donald Trump, even though some admit they don't trust the party.

Netanyahu denies allegations he's escalating tensions with Iran before Israel's election — Israelis are in the final hours of an intense election season amid reports of a clash between Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and the Israeli military over Iran.
Delegations meet in Iran with the Middle East on edge over potential for renewed fighting — Iran says diplomacy remains possible but rejects U.S. demands for surrender.

Trump promised to stop inflation. Now Republicans may pay the price in the midterm elections — Voters blame Trump, pointing to the Republican president's tariff policies and the war he started with Iran.

Attention, Passengers: High Airfares May Be Here to Stay — Ticket prices jumped after fuel costs spiked because of the war with Iran, but airlines say even an end to the conflict will not bring fares back down quickly.
Saudi Arabia Reopens Riyadh Airport Even as Houthis Threaten Further Strikes — The Houthis, an Iran-backed Yemeni militia, launched several deadly attacks on the airport this month.

Israel drills for surprise attack with massive military exercise as expert invokes 1973 war — Israel's largest military drill in years mobilizes multiple divisions to counter border infiltrations, as an analyst invokes the 1973 Yom Kippur War.

Iranians fear a possible return to all-out war as U.S. and Israeli elections approach — Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces a close vote Tuesday, says Iran's leadership must be eliminated. U.S. President Donald Trump vows to "finish the job" in Iran eight months after the war began, as a third aircraft carrier and thousands of troops make their way to the region.

A New Level of Threat and Fear Risks Pushing the U.S. and Iran Back to Full War — With new intelligence and the possibility of all sides seeking pretexts for action, the war in Iran is entering a dangerous phase ahead of elections in the United States and Israel.
